_comment: Shared by tools/preview.py and pi/vision/leafs.py, so what you frame in the browser is what the scanner analyses.
_sensor_mode_note: 2304x1296 uses the whole sensor. The default 1536x864 mode is a centre crop and looks zoomed in.
_zoom_note: 1.0 is the full frame. 2.0 crops to the middle half and scales back up.
